summary: Backend-only testing of the video upload fix for Mopado. All 13 pytest cases passed (100%). Verified: POST /api/upload/video accepts mp4 and webm (returns filename + size_mb), rejects non-video with 400 and message 'Type de fichier non supporté'; GET /api/videos/{filename} streams video/mp4 (404 for missing); Episode CRUD works with new video_filename field (no video_base64 in response); creating episode without video works (video_filename=null); DELETE /api/episodes/{id} removes the associated video file from filesystem; DELETE /api/videos/{filename} works and idempotently returns 404 the second time; GET /api/admin-panel serves HTML with the updated 500MB size limit mentioned.

minor.issue: No server-side max file size enforcement. Admin UI advertises 500MB but server will accept larger files. Consider explicit size check to return 413.
No authentication/authorization. Anyone can upload/delete videos. Add admin auth guard.
media_type is hardcoded to 'video/mp4' even when file is .webm/.mov/.avi. Should be derived from extension.
No path traversal protection. filename like '../../etc/passwd' is not sanitized before joining with VIDEOS_DIR.

action_items: Optional: Enforce a server-side max upload size (e.g., 500MB) and return 413 with a clear message.
Optional: Add auth guard to upload/delete/admin endpoints — currently public.
Optional: Derive media_type from file extension for GET /api/videos/{filename} (mp4/webm/mov/avi) instead of hardcoding 'video/mp4'.
Optional: Sanitize filename in GET/DELETE /api/videos/{filename} to prevent path traversal (validate uuid or use Path().name).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 627 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting routers by domain (auth, seasons, episodes, videos, admin).
Uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler.
datetime.utcnow() is used broadly; consider datetime.now(timezone.utc) for future-proofing.
MongoDB _id handled correctly via str_object_id helper — no ObjectId leaks in responses.
Video file save uses chunked reads (1MB) — good for large files and matches the 500MB use case.
seed_data_creation: Test episodes prefixed with TEST_ are created and cleaned up within the test suite (delete_episode calls). Two ephemeral videos uploaded (mp4, webm) and cleaned up (mp4 via episode delete cascade, webm via DELETE /api/videos).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (https://mopado-family-1.preview.emergentagent.com). All video-upload bug-fix tests pass. Season ID used: 6a78e7a45f87998d7ed8e2c3. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_video_upload.py.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: episode creation failed when videos > 16MB because base64-encoded video was persisted inside the MongoDB episode document, exceeding the 16MB per-document BSON limit. Fix implemented: introduce POST /api/upload/video that streams uploads to /app/backend/uploads/videos/ as files, store only the filename on the Episode document (video_filename), and serve via GET /api/videos/{filename}. DELETE /api/episodes/{id} now also removes the associated file. Verified end-to-end via pytest — 13/13 pass.
